info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupons API allows users to retrieve a list of available coupons applicable to their shopping cart. This endpoint is designed for e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance customer engagement through promotions and discounts. Developers can leverage this API to integrate coupon listings into shopping cart functionalities, enabling a seamless shopping experience. Typical consumers include online retailers and developers working on ecommerce solutions. By providing access to coupon information, businesses can support promotional strategies and improve conversion rates.

get.summary: Retrieve a coupon from the cart
get.description: This operation allows the user to retrieve a coupon that has been added to their cart. It provides details about the coupon, including its code and any applicable discounts.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve coupon details applied to the cart. Ensure the request body is correctly formatted to receive the data as expected.
